app.name: Mandi Advisor
app.tagline: Sell now or hold? Ask in your language.

login.title: Log in with your mobile number
login.googleFailed: Google sign-in failed. Try again, or log in with your mobile number.

auth.useOtp: Sign in with a mobile code instead

ask.placeholder: Type your question, e.g. Should I sell my onion now?
ask.empty: Ask about the mandi price of any vegetable, from onion and tomato to brinjal, okra, cauliflower and leafy greens, or whether to sell now or hold.
examples: Should I sell my onion now or wait?
I have 10 quintals of brinjal. Sell today?
What is the price of okra (bhindi) today?
ask.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ask.useLocation: Use my location for transport cost

voice.unsupported: Voice input is not available in this browser. Please type instead.
voice.failed: Could not hear clearly. Please speak again or type.
voice.denied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow the microphone for this site in your browser settings, then tap the mic again.
voice.noMic: No microphone was found. Connect or enable a microphone, or type your question.
voice.network: Voice recognition needs an internet connection and could not reach the speech service. Check your connection or type your question.
voice.insecure: Voice input only works on a secure (https) address or on localhost. Open the app over https, or type your question.
voice.hint: Say your question. The answer is read aloud, then I listen again.

prices.title: Mandi prices
prices.demo: These are demo (synthetic) prices, not real market reports.
prices.pickDate: See prices on an earlier date
prices.noData: No real market price for this period yet. Prices are added automatically every day.

settings.title: Settings
settings.keepRecordings: Let the server keep my voice recordings to improve speech recognition
settings.keepRecordingsHelp: Off by default. When off, recordings are deleted right after they are turned into text.
settings.subtitle: Your language, voice and market choices
settings.guestHint: Sign in to keep your questions and price alerts on any phone
settings.languageHelp: Questions and answers in this language
settings.appearanceHelp: Light, dark, or Auto to match the phone
settings.districtHelp: Prices from the markets in this district
settings.serverHelp: Where the app gets prices and answers

offline.banner: You are offline. Showing saved prices; answers need internet.
offline.noAnswer: You are offline. Connect to the internet to ask a question.

alerts.title: Price alerts
alerts.none: No alerts yet. Get notified when the price crosses a level.
alerts.pushNote: On the website, alerts appear here. The mobile app also sends a notification.
